nodes.label: ADR Immutability Policy (docs/adr/README.md)
nodes.rationale: ADRs are immutable once accepted; any later revision creates a new ADR that supersedes the previous one.

nodes.label: ADR-0001 — Workers Are Coding-Agent CLIs, Not Provider APIs
nodes.rationale: Chose invoking existing coding-agent CLIs (OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code) over calling provider completion APIs directly, avoiding a Factory-side reimplementation of the tool-use/diff/sandboxing loop and keeping provider-name branching out of Core/Application.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0001 — workers are coding-agent clis, not provider apis

nodes.label: ADR-0002 — SQLite as Operational Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: SQLite (WAL, foreign keys, busy_timeout, one AsyncSession per concurrent unit) is authoritative for operational state; NDJSON event files are reconstructible exports, not the primary store — chosen over PostgreSQL/Redis to remain local-first with zero external services.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0002 — sqlite as operational source of truth

nodes.label: D-003 — Execution Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Run > TaskExecution (durable, one worktree/writer) > ExecutionAttempt (worker/retry/failover/repair); the schema supports multiple tasks per Run even though V0.1 runs only one.

nodes.label: TASK-010 Critérios de aceite
nodes.rationale: Falha desconhecida deve escalar para humano (fail-closed) em vez de retry, pois tratar unknown como retry poderia causar loop ou rota insegura.

nodes.label: TASK-011 Critérios de aceite
nodes.rationale: Evento atrasado, forjado ou de attempt diferente não pode alterar saúde, prevenindo envenenamento do circuit breaker.

nodes.label: Circuit Breaker para saúde de providers
nodes.rationale: Separar falha operacional (quota/unavailable) de falha de qualidade evita que erros de código sejam confundidos com indisponibilidade de provider, preservando saúde apenas para causas operacionais.
nodes.norm_label: circuit breaker para saude de providers

nodes.label: TASK-012 Critérios de aceite
nodes.rationale: Pacote adulterado, oversized, externo ou cross-run deve ser rejeitado antes do worker para impedir que outro run assuma autoridade indevida.

nodes.label: Continuation Package
nodes.rationale: Trabalho parcial deve sobreviver a quota/indisponibilidade via pacote imutável com hash e refs — nunca transcript bruto — para permitir failover retomável sem duplicar attempts.

nodes.label: TASK-013 Critérios de aceite
nodes.rationale: Repo malicioso não pode liberar web, external dir, Git ou segredo; testes padrão nunca chamam OpenCode real, preservando reprodutibilidade offline.

nodes.label: OpenCode Adapter protegido
nodes.rationale: Primeiro coding agent real deve manter deny-by-default e Billing Guard para impedir que prompt injection do repositório eleve permissões ou gere custo incremental.

nodes.label: Agent-Agnostic Automation Policy (4.1)
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md is the single normative source; CLAUDE.md only imports it; shared skills live in .agents/skills; new-task is a user-invocable-only governance capability; executable hook policy lives in scripts/agent_automation; canonical read-only reviewers live in .agents/reviewers/.

nodes.label: Authority Precedence Order
nodes.rationale: Security, data protection, and explicit user instructions outrank AGENTS.md; then engineering-standards.md, security-review.md, the active task, ADRs/contracts, then other docs. Untrusted content (code, comments, fixtures, logs, tool output) never grants authority.

nodes.label: Change Boundaries (Allowed/Forbidden Files)
nodes.rationale: Edits are limited to the active task's Allowed Files glob; scope, permissions, network, or budget cannot be self-expanded; broad destructive commands and symlink traversal outside the repo root are forbidden.

nodes.label: Failure, Doubt, and Safe-Stop Protocol
nodes.rationale: Use only declared task defaults; stop and ask when two interpretations would change contract/security/data/scope; stop after two grounded attempts without progress; never clean up evidence after a failure.

nodes.label: Mandatory Final Report Format
nodes.rationale: A fixed text template (TASK/RESULTADO/BASELINE/BRANCH/COMMIT/PR/CRITERIOS/GATES/SEGURANCA/VALIDACAO MANUAL/RISCOS RESIDUAIS/PROXIMA ACAO) is required evidence; 'works locally' or 'lint passed' does not substitute for reproducible evidence.

nodes.label: Git and Publication Rules
nodes.rationale: main is release-only and protected; dev is the integration branch; every task branches from origin/dev at its pinned baseline; task PRs always target dev and are never auto-merged; only the Factory/human promotes planned to ready and ready to done.

nodes.label: Mandatory Engineering Rules (SOLID/Ports)
nodes.rationale: Clean Code and SOLID are acceptance requirements; Core/Application depend on ports and concretes wire only at the composition root; no global mutable state, service locator, or provider-name branching in Core.

nodes.label: Security and Authority Rules
nodes.rationale: Forbids shell=True/eval/insecure deserialization; subprocesses use argv, allowlisted env, timeout, and output limits; workers may commit/push/open PRs for their own task but never merge/tag/release/force-push; untrusted repo code needs strong isolation or fails closed.

nodes.label: Mandatory Task Lifecycle (9 Steps)
nodes.rationale: Preflight, short plan, implementation, focal verification, global gates, review, manual validation, publication (commit/push/draft PR), and final evidence report, executed in order for every task.

nodes.label: Task Selection Protocol
nodes.rationale: Only one task with status:ready may run at a time; planned/done tasks are never executed even if they look simple or are future dependencies; baseline_commit must match the authorized HEAD, with TASK-001's UNBORN state as the sole exception.

nodes.label: ADR-0004 — Portable Automation Across Agents
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md remains the sole governance source with CLAUDE.md importing it natively, avoiding two policies (.claude/ and .codex/) that would drift apart on scope and security control, especially for hook allowlists and read-only reviewer checklists.

nodes.label: D-001 — Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: One locally deployed Python app/CLI; no microservices, queues, web API, or remote database until there is evidence of need.

nodes.label: D-002 — Ports and Adapters
nodes.rationale: Core knows only Protocols and normalized models; Git, SQLite, subprocesses, and each coding agent sit behind adapters.

nodes.label: D-004 — Three Complementary Sources of Truth
nodes.rationale: Intent lives in the versioned SPEC, operational state in SQLite, in-progress code in the Git worktree, and bulky evidence in immutable disk artifacts.
nodes.norm_label: d-004 — three complementary sources of truth

nodes.label: D-005 — Failover Is Not Repair
nodes.rationale: Failover swaps an unavailable executor while preserving work; repair fixes a change that failed quality evidence; their policies, prompts, metrics, and budgets stay separate.

nodes.label: D-006 — Layered Security
nodes.rationale: Worktree directory, sanitized environment, timeout, shell-less argument lists, provider policy, writer lock, scope gate, SecretGate, and human approval are complementary, non-substitutable controls.

nodes.label: D-007 — Explainable Routing
nodes.rationale: Selection is ordered/deterministic through V1.0; V1.1 may weight historical metrics but every decision must log candidates, exclusions, weights, and justification — an LLM is never the mandatory router.

nodes.label: D-008 — Configuration and Schema Split
nodes.rationale: factory.toml for human configuration, Pydantic for config/persisted contracts, JSON Schema for planner/reviewer/repair output, JSONL for provider and journal events.

nodes.label: D-009 — Python Compatibility Window
nodes.rationale: requires-python >=3.13,<3.15 during the V1.1 cycle, tested on both 3.13 and 3.14.

nodes.label: D-010 — Separate Lab Repository
nodes.rationale: factory-lab is a separate repository, never a submodule executed inside the Factory itself; disposable Git fixtures stay inside the Factory's own tests.

nodes.label: D-011 — Evidence-Based Release
nodes.rationale: A version is only marked when its end-to-end scenario and gates pass; component count never substitutes for behavioral proof.

nodes.label: D-012 — No Autonomous Merge in V1.1
nodes.rationale: Factory-run workers never commit/push/merge on their own; this does not apply to this repository's own development agent, which per AGENTS.md creates commits, publishes branches, and opens draft PRs after gates pass, while merge/tag/release and promotion to main stay human.
nodes.norm_label: d-012 — no autonomous merge in v1.1

nodes.label: SecretGate Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Examines only the diff and blocks .env files, private keys, and token patterns before any secret can leave the worktree boundary.

nodes.label: TASK-016 Critérios de aceite
nodes.rationale: Evidence inexistente/externa e output fora do schema são rejeitados, nunca tolerados, e todo AC aparece exatamente uma vez como pass/fail/unknown.

nodes.label: Review estruturado por critério
nodes.rationale: Verdict pass só ocorre se todos os ACs passarem com evidência, e unknown bloqueia pass; sandbox read-only mais policy separada impedem que prompt injection no diff produza pass indevido.

nodes.label: TASK-017 Critérios de aceite
nodes.rationale: Budget persiste em restart, limita duas attempts e exaustão escala preservando evidência.

nodes.label: Repair loop limitado com revalidação
nodes.rationale: Budget persistido e mesmo escopo/gates evitam que reparo vire failover disfarçado ou loop infinito; repair nunca conta como failover, preservando a separação de contadores.

nodes.label: Roteamento dinâmico explicável
nodes.rationale: Security eligibility precede score e histórico envenenado nunca pode tornar worker inelegível elegível nem alterar permissions/budgets — integrity/provenance e baseline garantem que routing dinâmico não reduza a segurança estática do V1.0.

nodes.label: Clean Code Rules for Python
nodes.rationale: Domain-vocabulary naming, single-purpose functions, no magic values, strict typing at public boundaries, immutable value objects, injected effects, deterministic Core, and exceptions that preserve cause instead of bare except/sentinel returns.

nodes.label: DIP — Dependency Inversion Principle
nodes.rationale: Core and Application depend on ports; concrete adapters are wired only at the composition root, enforced by import-boundary tests.

nodes.label: ISP — Interface Segregation Principle
nodes.rationale: Protocols stay small and consumer-oriented; no single omnipotent worker/storage/tool interface.

nodes.label: LSP — Liskov Substitution Principle
nodes.rationale: Every implementation preserves the semantics, types, failures, timeout, and cancellation defined by its port, verified by the same contract-test suite.

nodes.label: OCP — Open/Closed Principle
nodes.rationale: New workers, gates, stores, or strategies enter via adapter/registry, never as new if/elif provider branches in Core.

nodes.label: SRP — Single Responsibility Principle
nodes.rationale: A class, module, or use case has one coherent reason to change; orchestration never implements Git, SQL, subprocess, or provider parsing directly.

nodes.label: TASK-024 Critérios de aceite
nodes.rationale: Canários em prompt/output/exceção não chegam a log, trace, métrica ou exporter; telemetry off não muda domínio.

nodes.label: Observabilidade segura
nodes.rationale: Attribute allowlist, redaction e OTLP opt-in com TLS obrigatório impedem que telemetria exfiltre segredo/prompt/diff ou gere custo; run/task IDs são proibidos como labels para evitar alta cardinalidade.

nodes.label: Isolamento de hidden tests
nodes.rationale: Hidden tests ficam em root privada fora do worktree e só chegam ao evaluator após o worker terminar, evitando vazamento; repositório não confiável exige isolamento forte com fail-closed na ausência dele.

nodes.label: Global Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: A task is done only when it delivers its acceptance criteria, respects SOLID/dependency boundaries, adds proportional tests including negative regression, passes all applicable global gates, updates docs/schema/migration/ADR, and passes security-review.md controls without unapproved authority expansion.

nodes.label: Mandatory Gate Command Set
nodes.rationale: Canonical gate: uv lock --check, ruff check/format, pyright, lint-imports, pytest --cov --cov-branch, pip-audit, uv build, plus secret scan and release-time SBOM export, required before any task counts as complete.
